subject: Marketplace evidence & launch staging - CloudBolt Labs
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara@cloudbolt.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudbolt.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace onboarding - evidence and launch staging

Hi Aditya / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. CloudBolt Labs is excited to list our new observability add-on for LLM inference in the Redwood marketplace and explore co-sell. Before we schedule the technical review, Procurement asked for a short list of evidence and a recommended staging timeline so they can align legal/compliance.

Can you confirm the minimal evidence set Redwood requires for a public GA listing and any items needed for co-sell (marketplace certification, joint collateral, referral terms)?

High-level asks from our side:
- A checklist of security/compliance artifacts (SOC/SIEM samples, data retention notes)
- Expected time between evidence submission and listing approval
- Any co-sell prerequisites (partner signup, solution brief, lead routing)

I attached the export from our SIEM showing ingestion and masking (SIEM_export_2027-05.zip) and a draft one-pager with product positioning.

Thanks,
Sara Kim
Head of Partnerships
CloudBolt Labs
(sara@cloudbolt.com)

Attachment: SIEM_export_2027-05.zip (zip)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara@cloudbolt.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding - evidence and launch staging

Sara — great to see this coming together. Short answers up front, then a suggested next step.

Quick answers:
- Minimal evidence for a public listing: security questionnaire (completed), SOC 2 or equivalent summary, sample logs (redacted) or SIEM export, a data flow diagram, and a privacy/data retention statement.
- For co-sell: signed partner agreement and a go-to-market plan (one-pager) plus a lead routing contact for RD to pull leads into our CRM.
- Typical review window after we have evidence: 7–12 business days for the initial marketplace QA + listing copy review. Co-sell enablement (sales playbook + joint collateral) adds another 2–3 weeks.

I uploaded our internal checklist and a template we use for partner evidence: marketplace-evidence-checklist.pdf (attached). Please fill any fields you can and re-send. We also require a short statement confirming no unredacted customer PII is included in artifacts (you can redact in the SIEM export).

Proposed next step: can we do a short 30-min intake on Wednesday to go over the checklist and routing? Vanessa — can you confirm availability? Ben, flag anything procurement/contracting wise we should mention to CloudBolt (T&Cs, revenue share range).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachment: marketplace-evidence-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara@cloudbolt.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding - evidence and launch staging

Sara — quick procurement note from our side.

For co-sell/certification we typically need:
- A signed Partner Master Services Agreement (PMSA) or an executed marketplace listing addendum (we can route a simple addendum for ISVs)
- Standard revenue share band (we usually start conversations in the 70/30 to 80/20 direction depending on lead ownership and tech support)
- Invoices must be compatible with our finance system — we can share billing requirements once partner legal confirms entity and tax info.

If you want to expedite, indicate whether CloudBolt will accept our standard marketplace addendum (I can send a redline-friendly DocuSign). Otherwise, loop legal and we can schedule a contracting checkpoint.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Thanks for the materials, Sara — the checklist looks mostly complete. A couple of items to close before intake:

1) Please confirm redaction of customer identifiers in the SIEM_export (we need a signed statement if redaction is not possible).
2) Fill the "support model" section in the checklist (managed vs co-managed; SLAs).
3) Provide a point-of-contact for lead routing (email + slack).

Once those are in place, we can schedule the 30-min intake and open the marketplace draft. Tentative timeline: intake this week, listing draft published to our staging catalog next week (internal QA 7–10 business days), public listing ~3 business days after QA signoff. Co-sell prep (one-pager + playbook) to follow in parallel.

If it helps, here are two links: draft checklist in Drive and the internal draft listing URL.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdMarketChecklistDraft
Staging listing: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/listing/drafts/CBL-2027-06

I'll propose times via calendar. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Partnerships, NA
Redwood Inference
